- [Writer](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/products/extensions/migration-assistant/concept/writer.md): Writer: The Writer objects will get the converted data from the swagmigrationdata table and write it to the right Shopware 6 table. Each Writer supports only one entity, which is most likely the target table.
